description_en: Changes the resource group to which a scaling group belongs. Resource groups allow you to group your cloud resources, such as scaling groups, by purpose, permissions, and ownership to implement hierarchical resource management for multiple users and projects within an enterprise. You can call the ChangeResourceGroup operation to move a scaling group from one resource group to another. This allows you to centrally monitor and manage the scaling group in the new resource group, eliminating the need to check resources across multiple Alibaba Cloud services
description_zh: 资源组指对您拥有的云资源（例如伸缩组资源）从用途、权限、归属等维度上进行分组，实现企业内部多用户、多项目的资源分级管理。您可以调用API ChangeResourceGroup将伸缩组资源从一个资源组更改到另一个资源组，在新的资源组里集中监控和管理该伸缩组资源，免去了您在多种阿里云服务间反复查看资源的负担
kebab_example: aliyun ess change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id asg-bp17xb4x1vr29lgt0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aek2ckjqe300000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Currently, only scaling groups are supported. Valid value: scalinggroup
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，目前仅支持伸缩组。取值：scalinggroup
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group whose resource group you want to change
parameters.help_zh: 待修改资源组的伸缩组ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group to which you want to move the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 将伸缩组更改到新的资源组后，新资源组的ID
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id
